title: Learning Scientific Trajectories to Predict Future Biomedical Discoveries
abstract: arXiv:2610.38719v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI co-scientists have expanded the use of large language models for generating scientific hypotheses and guiding experimental investigation. Here we investigate whether temporal patterns in the semantic representations of complete biomedical conclusions can guide hypothesis generation. We introduce ForeSCITE, a framework that identifies thematic clusters of published conclusions, estimates a direction separating earlier from more recent findings within each cluster, and projects existing conclusion embeddings along these directions. An embedding language model trained to reconstruct conclusions decodes the projected coordinates into natural-language hypotheses. Across 407 clusters derived from approximately three million pre-cutoff conclusions, we identify temporal structure and illustrate its retention after decoding. translated_title: 学习科学轨迹以预测未来的生物医学发现
translated_abstract: AI 共同科学家已经扩展了大型语言模型在生成科学假设和指导实验研究方面的应用。本文研究了完整生物医学结论的语义表征中的时间模式是否能够指导假设的生成。我们提出了 ForeSCITE，这是一个框架，用于识别已发表结论的主题聚类，在每个聚类内估计出区分早期发现与近期发现的方向，并沿着这些方向对现有结论嵌入进行投影。一个经过训练以重建结论的嵌入语言模型将投影后的坐标解码为自然语言假设。基于从大约三百万条截止日期前的结论中得出的 407 个聚类，我们识别出了时间结构，并展示了该结构在解码后仍得以保留。在回顾性的、按时间切分的评估中，ForeSCITE 将语义覆盖范围提升到了历史语料库之外……
tldr: 本文提出 ForeSCITE 框架，通过学习生物医学结论嵌入中主题聚类内的时间方向模式，并利用嵌入语言模型将投影坐标解码为自然语言假设，从而预测未来的生物医学发现。
en_tdlr: ForeSCITE learns temporal directions within thematic clusters of biomedical conclusion embeddings and decodes projected coordinates into natural-language hypotheses, enabling the prediction of future biomedical discoveries.
